description.value: Hill's Native Art is a long-established BC chain specializing in Indigenous Canadian art, jewelry, and cultural items. The Vancouver Broadway location brings authentic First Nations artwork to a neighbourhood commercial strip in Vancouver. Touring cyclists passing through would encounter a curated gallery focused on West Coast Indigenous traditions.
